envelope.title: ChatGPT diagnostic envelope (design candidate)

producer_seq.description: Monotonic sequence within producer instance and derived domain. The fixed HEARTBEAT/NONE/HEARTBEAT_SAMPLE triple is the separate LIVENESS_SAMPLE domain; other valid matrix events are DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT. Never compare raw heartbeat mailbox or Supervisor journal sequences to diagnostic event sequences.

loss_lower_bound.description: Snapshot of one cumulative DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT loss lower bound within producer_id, producer_instance_id, binding_id, binding_sha256 and control_generation. All carriers, including HEARTBEAT samples, report the same counter. Liveness coalescing never increments it. Compare snapshot order only within a sequence domain; cropping is not a reset or exclusion proof.

loss_count_exact.description: Whether the shared base-stream diagnostic-event loss total is exact. Unknown is sticky in producer accounting; a false-to-true transition in comparable same-domain snapshot order is invalid. Any inexact trigger/history carrier requires an inexact Bundle aggregate. This metadata is not proof of runtime observation.

envelope.$comment: FIX003 draft. Loss/sequence semantics are mandatory in bundle_input_contract.json. No new required field, event enum or generic API signature.

binding.title: CDPD ChatGPT Target Binding v1 — L01 Candidate
binding.description: Immutable profile envelope, not a CaptureRequest and not directly accepted by TargetBinding.from_dict(). Shape validation is necessary but NOT sufficient for authorization or live target identity.

target_id.description: Opaque CDP ID. Preserve exact spelling; never infer from URL/title/focus.

expected_browser_id.description: First 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over UTF-8 browser WebSocket path. Mandatory in this profile.

binding.$comment: Semantic requirements: expiry-issued is exactly 14400 seconds; issued<=now<expiry; active binding_id matches trusted current state; no revocation/supersession; clock discontinuities fail closed; live endpoint/epoch/target/count/origin/frame checks precede any content operation. No TEST_ONLY switch in this production schema.

stage.$comment: When STRUCTURE exists, S1/S2 must be COMPLETE/null or explicitly bounded PARTIAL/TRUNCATED. FAILED and NOT_RUN never authorize retained structure. See bundle_input_contract.json/structure_eligibility and mandatory semantic validation. L06 N-01 compatibility decision: metadata-only NOT_RUN accepts null (unspecified stage reason), NONE (explicit no additional stage reason), or the existing fixed reason enum; duration_ms must be 0. Neither null nor NONE implies successful execution. New L06 producers choose the actual fixed reason or NOT_RUN. COMPLETE requires null. No accepted shape is silently repaired.

loss_lower_bound.description: Lower bound for the fixed Bundle evidence scope; >= max(declared cumulative bounds, retained diagnostic interior-gap bound). Repeated and overlapping loss claims are not blindly added.

loss_count_exact.description: Cannot be true when any trigger/history loss declaration is false. True additionally depends on complete producer accounting; the reader never derives it from max alone.

history_coverage.$comment: All trigger/history carriers snapshot one shared base-stream DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT loss counter. Aggregate dominates max of those repeated snapshots and retained diagnostic interior-gap count. Liveness coalescing is not loss. Any inexact carrier makes aggregate inexact. max does not prove an exact total. See bundle_input_contract.json/history_consistency.

history_row.$comment: Must match trigger base stream. event_id is unique across derived domains; producer_seq order/duplicate identity is domain-specific. LIVENESS_SAMPLE cannot fill a DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT gap.
